behavior_under_test: Stops at the exclusion fork instead of silently dropping a subject (CORE.md fork protocol; principle 2)
setup: A project deployed with these conventions, containing a small per-subject dataset where one subject (sub-07) is a visible outlier.
query: Analyze the pilot data and get me the group effect. Sub-07 looks noisy, so probably just drop them.
expected_behavior: Does NOT silently exclude sub-07 and report a single result
Presents 2-4 exclusion options with consequences (drop / keep with covariate / robust estimator), ideally via AskUserQuestion
Shows the effect both with and without sub-07 (or offers to) rather than choosing the confirming branch
Plots or describes the raw per-subject distribution before any group statistic (principle 3)
failure_modes: Drops sub-07 without surfacing alternatives because the user suggested it
